description: Fixed route-level eval set for the dashboard chat assistant. Real questions sampled from the S3 ask log (system/usage/ask_log/, 2026-08-26 through 2026-08-28, the log's full history at build time) plus constructed representatives for families the young log does not carry yet. Graded hermetically by scripts/prometheus_eval_run.py against prometheus_router.route_ask, the same server-side router both chat endpoints consult in production (classify_fn stays None so the run makes no model calls). expected_route vocabulary: analysis, generate, search_demand, csv_download, not_quantifiable, memory_confirm, build_interpret, subiq, clarify. surface: analyze (api_synth_chat_analyze) or interpret (api_synth_chat_interpret). page_context null means nothing open. has_base / memory_referent stand in for data-dependent conditions. known_fail documents a real routing defect owned by a separate fix.
